title: Gridshell form-finding by large deformation (Theory III)
description_for_llm: Form finds a gridshell by pushing a FLAT grid of beam members through Karamba's Large Deformation (Theory III incremental) analysis, then re-assembles and reports the deformed state. Feed a flat, connected grid of lines; anchor its boundary. ALMOND_IN_MAXDISP_M is the form-finding target: the maximum displacement per increment in metres (the original template used 6 m over 20 increments). The displacement output is the FORM-FINDING movement (how far the grid rose/sank into its shell shape), NOT a serviceability deflection - validate_structure's L/250 check is not meaningful here; use run_gh_definition and read the deformed state directly. No load input: the push comes from the template's internal load and increments. HARNESSED 2026-08-30 from 04_LargeDeformationTriangularGridshell.ghx. STATUS 2026-08-30: the harness (ALMOND_IN_LINES / ALMOND_IN_MAXDISP_M / ALMOND_IN_INCREMENTS / ALMOND_IN_SUPPORTS, outputs wired) is complete and deployed to harnessed/, but Karamba's Large Deformation Analysis hangs headless on the trial license even for an 8-member grid at 4 increments (>5 min), so no verified run exists and audited stays FALSE. Re-verify on a licensed Karamba before flipping the flag.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_LINES
inputs.description: Flat grid of member axis lines, node-merged at shared endpoints. Keep at or under 20 members on a Karamba trial license.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_MAXDISP_M
inputs.description: Form-finding target: maximum displacement per increment in metres.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_SUPPORTS
inputs.description: Support node positions. When omitted the validator supplies the lowest-Z nodes of the input members automatically.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_INCREMENTS
inputs.description: Number of large-deformation increments. Keep small (3-6): each increment is a full solve and the original template's 20 makes headless runs exceed practical timeouts.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_DISP_MM
outputs.description: Largest nodal displacement; Karamba emits centimetres, converted downstream per these units.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_MASS_KG
outputs.description: Total structural mass of the model.
